{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust downward for persistent negative sentiment, as models tend to overreact to pessimism.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when price deviates >15% from recent 5-day average, especially after volatility spikes.",
    "Lower forecasts when sentiment history shows repeated negative signals (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over 3+ consecutive days.",
    "Increase downward bias for forecasts when true outcome is consistently below model output, especially in low volatility regimes.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast windows (e.g., 1-3 days ahead) when sentiment is positive but recent price action is weak.",
    "Apply upward correction if true outcome is significantly below model forecast and sentiment is neutral or slightly positive, indicating model underestimation of market resilience."
  ]
}
